string.text: I don't know what to say... Should I be happy or sad? I found out that I am Strelok. A legendary stalker who lost his memory after one of several successful expeditions into the center of the Zone. A stalker who lost all of his friends except for the Doctor. A stalker who found out something that made him a target. What did I find out that caused me to be followed?\n \n The Doctor managed to save the key and the location of the secret stash of our group at Pripyat. It's located in one of the rooms of the old hotel in the center. He says that there must be something there that will shed some light on the "Granter of Wishes" or the Monolith. He knows only one thing: after the second to last scouting expedition to the Chernobyl NPP I kept on saying that there's something shady about the Monolith. Well, Monolith, we're going to try and deal with you. Find out exactly who or what you are.
Doctor： 我々が最後に会った時、君は Pripyat にある秘密の隠し場所の鍵と、それを見つける手順を私に残した… 私はそれを守るよう手配した… Mercs はそれを見つけることが出来なかった… ここだ… おそらく、君はそこで他の何かを見つけるだろう… そして更に、君はモノリスに何か疑わしい物があるとつぶやき続けた… 間違いない…。
